title: Talax's Lobotomy Shaders
description: EPILEPSY WARNING! I would not recommend trying to beat the game with it.
body:
**Significant epilepsy risk!** _Please be careful and do not use these shaders if you have epilepsy._

These shaders are a combination of many induced visual glitches and effects. The purpose of this shader is to simply have fun, and to test the waters of making shaders for games.

Lobotomy Shaders significantly impacts visibility by distorting the geometries of both blocks and mobs, it can be a bit difficult to play the game with them on. 

It is recommended you play in third person, as the player character itself gets distorted and obstructs your own view.
